<script type="text/javascript">
function updateRatingsChart_norm() {
    var gd = document.getElementById('ratings-norm-chart');
    if (!gd) return;
    
    var showElo = document.getElementById('chk-elo-norm').checked;
    var showOff = document.getElementById('chk-off-norm').checked;
    var showDef = document.getElementById('chk-def-norm').checked;
    
    var visArray = [];
    var numTeams = 10;
    
    for (var i = 0; i < numTeams; i++) {
        var teamChk = document.getElementById('chk-team-' + i + '-norm').checked;
        visArray.push(teamChk && showElo);
        visArray.push(teamChk && showOff);
        visArray.push(teamChk && showDef);
    }
    
    Plotly.restyle(gd, {visible: visArray});
}
</script>
